output.reason: The question asks what to read before quoting a specialty cost. E-SOP-09 is the specialty-specific estimate wording itself, so it answers that on its own. E-SOP-08 only says to read the wording word for word and does not give it. The 30-day retail disclaimers (U-RX-EDU-001-09, U-RX-EDU-002-07, E-SOP-10) do not cover specialty supply. Note that more than the stated maximum of three units were provided.
